maximum_depth_rule: The reviewed source is a set of December 2024 indicator-change booklets. Extracted lines may combine current values, target values, annotations, duplicated table text, and several series. Every line remains a raw maximum-depth record until a reviewed structured table mapping is available.
plan_boundary: Policy-promotion, reconstruction-promotion, and the four regional-promotion booklets remain separate source documents. Their rows are not merged into one inferred indicator table, and no administrative-management series is inherited automatically.
non_goals: Do not parse mixed raw lines into inferred current and target values.
Do not merge rows from separate policy, reconstruction, or regional plan booklets.
Do not treat change annotations as independent policy results.
Do not calculate achievement, causality, or cross-prefecture ranking.
